title: Review suspicious command arg space
why: An executable string containing a whole command may be passed as one executable name rather than a program plus separate arguments.
suggestion: Keep the executable and its arguments separate, or confirm that the executable path itself intentionally contains spaces. Spaces in later argument values are valid.
limitations: Only a directly written executable string or first literal argv entry is examined; later argument values, including labels, scripts, and filenames, may legitimately contain whitespace.
Whole command strings passed to Python subprocess calls with shell=True and expressions using split() are excluded. Dynamic executable expressions and executable-path intent are not inferred.
